why: SWINGSURV_r528 compared two reflex GAINS on survival-matched cells and was described as settling Limitation 2, which is about the ARM contrast. They are different questions. This asks the arm question on the main corpus, where pure-weakness cells exist.
definition: a family is intact if every one of its admitted cells reaches 20 s
VERDICT: no arm contrast exists under survival matching on the main corpus, because no hyperreflexia family has every admitted seed reaching the horizon. The confound is a property of the corpus and is not escaped by changing the readout. Any claim that a new endpoint 'escapes Limitation 2' on the strength of SWINGSURV_r528 is wrong: that container compares two reflex GAINS, not the two arms.
